_comment: Copy to data/decision-endpoints.json (gitignored) and keep the entries you want, or use the app's Decision ▾ > Connect a decision model. Each entry becomes a driver named decision:<name> that receives exactly the state and questions the built-in Jev driver does. The endpoint must speak TypeSafe's System One protocol: POST {base_url}{path} with {model, state, questions}. path defaults to /v1/systemone (TypeSafe, llama.cpp); OpenRouter's Decisions API is /api/alpha/decisions. check_path is a free GET used to report whether the endpoint is reachable and the key accepted (default /v1/models). Keys never go in this file: api_key_env names a variable in .env or the environment. Prices are USD per million tokens; when the provider reports usage.cost (OpenRouter does) that is used instead. rpm 0 removes the rate limit for a free local server. These drivers have been tested only against a local mock server. See docs/agents.md.
